meta.title: CVC catalog sync
meta.description: Keeps the CheapVibeCode route's model list in the profile patch in sync with /v1/models and with the reasoning levels published by the official installer. Runs at startup and on a timer, writes only when the catalog or the subagent allowlist changed, adds the cvc_catalog tool, and puts every setting on the plugin's own page in Plugins and on a Settings → CVC catalog page, both with check and apply actions.
